description: Screenshot of a Fox News Channel 'Special Report' on-screen graphic comparing GDP estimates of G7 nations. Six other G7 members' figures are listed and totaled at $19.2 trillion, contrasted against the United States at $20.4 trillion. The chyron references Trump's tariff disputes with allies; a video play button overlays the center.
text: GDP ESTIMATES. IN TRILLIONS OF U.S. DOLLARS. Canada: $1.8. France: $2.9. Germany: $4.2. Italy: $2.2. United Kingdom: $2.9. Japan : $5.2. Total: $19.2. United States $20.4. FOX NEWS channel. "UNFAIR TRADE DEALS". TRUMP RAGES AGAINST ALLIES ON TARIFFS. SPECIAL REPORT.

description: Screenshot of two Q posts (tripcode !UW.yye1fxo, ID 2362f9) dated March 6, 2018, each linking to a WikiLeaks Clinton-emails page. The first post poses questions alleging children in Haiti are 'in high demand' and smuggled via an 'adoption' process, urging readers to track donations; the second asks who people are taught to trust most. These are the drops' claims, presented without evidence.
text: Mar 6 2018 13:06:24 Q !UW.yye1fxo ID: 2362f9. 568863→ NEW. https://wikileaks.org/clinton-emails/emailid/629→. So much is open source. So much left to be connected. Why are the children in Haiti in high demand?. How are they smuggled out?. 'Adoption' process. Local 'staging' ports friendly to CF?. Track donations. Cross against location relative to Haiti. Think logically. The choice, to KNOW, will be yours. Q. Mar 6 2018 13:10:24 Q !UW.yye1fxo ID: 2362f9 5. NEW. >>568863. https://wikileaks.org/clinton-emails/emailid/3672→. Who are we taught to trust the most?. This will not be easy. The END. Q
flags: Post alleges child smuggling in Haiti tied to the Clinton Foundation ('CF'); unverified claim documented as the drop's claim

description: Political meme on an American-flag background from RebelNationUSA listing activities said to require photo ID, arguing that requiring ID to vote is not racist. Two columns of bullet-pointed examples are followed by rhetorical questions in red and blue text; a Facebook group URL appears at the bottom.
text: RebelNationUSA.com. This is just a small list of things requiring ID, but not considered racist. * Purchase Alcohol. * Purchase Cigarettes. * Open Bank Account. * Apply for Food Stamps. * Apply for Welfare. * Apply for Medicaid. * Apply for Social Security. * Apply for a Job. * Apply for Mortgage. * Apply for a Unemployment. * Apply Hunting License. * Apply for Fishing License. * Rent a House/Appartment. * Buy a House/Condo. * Drive a Car. * Rent a Car. * Buy a Car. * Register a Car. * Rent a Hotel/Motel Room. * Buy an "M" Rated Video Game. * Boarding an Airplane. * Get Married. * Purchase a Gun. * Purchase Ammo for Gun. * Adopt a Pet. * Get a Prescription. * Donate Blood. * Pawn Shop Transactions. Showing ID to Vote is Considered Racist?. HOW STUPID IS THAT?. facebook.com/groups/RebelNationUSA
flags: Advocacy meme; the list's implied equivalence between these activities and voting is a political argument, not a verified claim

description: Top section of the widely shared 'Media Consolidation: The Illusion of Choice' infographic (circa 2011). It states that 6 media giants control 90% of American media, contrasts 50 owning companies in 1983 with 6 in 2011 using dot graphics, and lists the six companies — GE, News Corp, Disney, Viacom, Time Warner, CBS — with their logos and notable properties.
text: Media Consolidation:. THE ILLUSION OF CHOICE. Media has never been more consolidated. 6 media giants now control a staggering 90% of what we read, watch, or listen to. 1. CONSOLIDATION. 1983. 2011. In 1983, 90% of American media was owned by 50 companies. In 2011, that same 90% is controlled by 6 companies. THESE SIX COMPANIES ARE:. GE Notable Properties: COMCAST. NBC. UNIVERSAL PICTURES. FOCUS FEATURES. NEWS-CORP Notable Properties: FOX. WALL STREET JOURNAL. NEW YORK POST. DISNEY Notable Properties: ABC. ESPN. PIXAR. MIRAMAX. MARVEL STUDIOS. VIACOM Notable Properties: MTV. NICK JR. BET. CMT. PARAMOUNT PICTURES. TIME WARNER Notable Properties: CNN. HBO. TIME. WARNER BROS. CBS Notable Properties: SHOWTIME. SMITHSONIAN CHANNEL. NFL.COM. JEOPARDY. 60 MINUTES
flags: Statistics reflect the infographic's own 2011-era claims; ownership figures are the graphic's assertion and predate later corporate changes

description: Promotional in-flight photograph of a Bombardier Q400 NextGen twin-turboprop airliner in the manufacturer's white-and-blue house livery, flying over snow-covered mountain ranges. The fuselage carries 'Q400 NextGen' titles, the tail bears a large 'Q' logo, and 'www.Q400.com' is painted on the rear fuselage. Aircraft type identified from the livery text and distinctive high-wing, T-tail Dash 8 configuration.
flags: Mountain location not identified; manufacturer publicity image
